title: The Visitor Help Desk · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about yourself. Use 'I am' and 'You are'. Say your name and your room. Example: I am Li. I am at Room 3. You are a teacher.
Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
